_owner: Our own channel, @stimpunks. This is a playlist we published, not somebody else's curation carried over here.
_source: 2026-09-20: the ids below were extracted from the playlist page's own ytInitialData and then cross-checked against the playlist panel on the watch page, which is a second rendering of the same list rather than a second guess at it. Titles, channels and runtimes were resolved against YouTube's oEmbed endpoint and the playlist panel, NOT typed from memory — the mapping of artist to video id is the exact fabrication this site spends a page arguing against. Every id was then put through the same playabilityStatus check check-jukebox.py uses, and all thirteen answered OK.
_count: THE PLAYLIST HEADER SAYS 15 AND THIRTEEN RENDER. YouTube counts private and deleted entries in that total and shows nothing at all for them to anybody but the owner, so the two missing ones cannot be read from outside. Thirteen is what plays, and thirteen is what is published. Ryan owns the playlist and can see the other two; if they are meant to be here, add them and re-run the tool.
_rule: The vibe, not the lyrics. Same rule as the room next door: we name the artist, link the song, and let them keep their own words. The notes below are ours about why a track is in a room called Unabashed Pleasure and Righteous Inclusion — none of them paraphrase a lyric. Nothing here is hosted by us.

playlist._runtime: NO RUNTIME ON THIS ONE, AND make-chappell.py REFUSES TO LET IT HAVE ONE. Every niche in this room says how long before you press it, because a twenty-three minute concert sits beside three-minute videos and one press is only consent if you know what you are agreeing to. A playlist has no such number: it is a list we keep adding to, today's total is wrong the next time it changes, and an authoritative-looking wrong number is worse than none. So this label says it runs until you stop it, and the room's own consent banner says which kind of button does which. make-club.py holds the identical pair of rules on Club Chronic's stage; make-jungle.py refuses a runtime on a live camera and make-den.py requires one on a song. They are the same promise.
playlist._frame: The videoseries form of the playlist we already link at the top of the arcade, on youtube-nocookie, which is an origin love-embed.js has built for since the street opened -- so nothing was added to ORIGINS and the Content-Security-Policy did not move. NO RANDOM START HERE: Ryan's call, 2026-09-22. Club Chronic's stage drops the needle somewhere in a five-hundred-track list because nobody is going to hear the end of it; this is thirteen videos that were put in an order, and starting in the middle of a running order somebody chose would be overruling them.
